invariants: Any receipt with confirmed/applied payment or canonical payment evidence must be visible in Cobros y cartera and in Cliente 360 > Cobros.
Policy lifecycle status may limit future/open portfolio, but must never suppress historical payment visibility.
A paid receipt may not appear only in Recibos y pagos while being absent from Cobros.
If a canonical cobro document already exists for a receipt, Cobros must render that cobro and must not duplicate it with receipt evidence.
If a paid/evidenced receipt lacks a currently visible cobro projection, Cobros must render a read-only payment-evidence projection until the canonical cobro is visible/materialized.
CRM/SIGA direct-payment evidence remains paid evidence pending reconciliation; it exposes individual Conciliar and may also participate in deterministic batch reconciliation.
Advisor-reported payment remains distinct from CLIENT_PORTAL and does not become a paid receipt before operative validation.

Estado filtering in Cobros must be operable in the supported browser surface. The current state choices must remain reachable: Pagado, Pendiente, Vencido, Pago registrado en SIGA, Por conciliar, Reportado por asesor, Reportado por cliente, Conciliado, Requiere validación, Bloqueado, Anulado.
Search/filter changes must not require a full rehydration or remove paid receipts from the read model.

filterContract.nativeSelectToolingUncertainty: Do not assume the TinyFish embedded-browser symptom is product-only. Source must nevertheless expose a robust operable state control and contract coverage.
